general.title: General Settings
general.llmCacheDescription: Enable prompt caching for LLM providers (mainly affects Anthropic)
general.modelsDevDescription: Complete model pricing, context limits and capabilities from the models.dev catalog when the provider does not report them. Downloaded once per instance and cached for 24 h; if unavailable, models keep their provider metadata and no cost is shown
general.outputFilterDescription: Compress noisy command output (test runners, builds, installers) before it reaches the model to save tokens. Fail-safe and on by default; errors are never dropped
general.cavemanDescription: Reduces output-token usage by giving shorter explanations and removing filler. It keeps code, commands, errors, reasoning quality, tool use, and verification intact. Output savings vary; input and reasoning tokens are not reduced. This is the default for new sessions; a session that ran /caveman keeps its own level.
general.toolDiscoveryDescription: Keep non-core tools out of the initial context; the model finds them on demand via tool_search
general.autoCompactDescription: Automatically compress conversation context when it grows large
general.showHiddenFilesDescription: Show dotfiles and hidden files in the file tree
general.nerdFontsDescription: Use Nerd Font glyphs for TUI icons. Disable if your terminal lacks a patched Nerd Font and icons render as boxes (□)
general.telemetryEnabled: Send Logs & Diagnostics to Pando Developers
general.telemetryEnabledDescription: Off by default. When enabled, sends your app logs (at or above the level below), crash reports, and version/OS info to help diagnose problems — tagged with an anonymous debug ID, not your identity. Secrets are redacted before anything is sent, and no code or prompt content is included by design. Turn this on when reporting an issue, then share your debug ID with us.
general.telemetryUnavailableHint: Not available in this build (no telemetry ingest token configured)
general.delegationEnabledDescription: Capture delegated-task conclusions and re-enter the parent agent loop
general.delegationInjectIntoLiveLoopDescription: Case A: inject a conclusion into a still-running parent loop
general.delegationResurrectIdleLoopDescription: Case B: resurrect an idle parent session when a correlated task completes
general.delegationSynthesizeFallbackDescription: Synthesize a conclusion when the subagent omits the block
general.delegationReuseWarmInstancesDescription: Route a delegated task to an already-running per-project instance instead of cold-spawning a CLI subprocess
general.delegationAutoStartWarmDescription: Auto-start a child instance for the project when none is running (off = reuse only)
general.delegationWarmQueueDepth: Warm Queue Depth (0 = cold-spawn at cap)
general.delegationAllowExternalWarmTargetsDescri: Route a delegated task to an external (editor-launched) peer over IPC instead of cold-spawning a CLI (the peer must accept delegations)
general.delegationAcceptDelegationsDescription: Let this instance accept incoming delegation requests from peer instances over IPC
general.delegationConclusionGateDescription: Downgrade a delegated task's "success" to "partial" when the files or memory refs it cites do not exist
general.delegationBreakerDescription: Refuse to relaunch or retry a task that hit the failure limit, failed on authentication, or is inside a rate-limit cooldown
general.delegationEventLogDescription: Record every terminal task outcome on disk and deliver it through an acked cursor, so a signal dropped by the in-memory bus or lost to a restart is replayed instead of vanishing
general.orchestratorMaxPerEngine: Max tasks per engine (0 = no limit)

tokenOptimization.title: Token Optimization
tokenOptimization.description: Reduce context/token usage across shell output, file reads and the code index. These knobs are additive and fail-safe: compressed reads never cost more than the raw read, and the defaults preserve today's behavior.
tokenOptimization.readModeDefaultDescription: Fidelity used by the view tool when a call does not request a mode. 'full' returns the raw window (default), 'signatures'/'map' return a compact structural projection with line numbers, and 'auto' picks one by file size and type.
tokenOptimization.readDedupDescription: When re-reading an unchanged window in the same session, return a short reference instead of re-sending the content.
tokenOptimization.readModeLearningDescription: Let the auto resolver learn when compression backfires and upgrade fidelity for affected files. Off keeps reads deterministic.
tokenOptimization.outputFilterDescription: Apply the RTK-style filter pipeline to shell command output (git/build/test/lint), trimming noise while preserving exit codes.
tokenOptimization.outputFilterPathsDescription: Additional TOML filter definitions (user-global or project paths) layered on top of the built-in filters.
tokenOptimization.outputFilterPathsPlaceholder: Add a path to a TOML filter file…
tokenOptimization.buildCodeGraphDescription: Extract import/call/reference edges during indexing to power impact analysis and related-file hints. (Index controls live in KB & Code Index.)
tokenOptimization.relatedFilesHintDescription: Append a token-bounded list of related files to reads and search results.
tokenOptimization.savingsLedgerDescription: Track how many tokens the filter, read modes and dedup saved, for the savings report.
tokenOptimization.savingsWidgetEmpty: No savings recorded yet. Reads and shell commands populate the ledger as you work.

webuiAccess.title: WebUI Access
webuiAccess.enabledDescription: Ask for credentials before letting anyone reach the API. Only takes effect while Pando runs on a non-localhost host.
webuiAccess.enforced: Active: Pando is running on {{host}}, so it is reachable from the network and every client — including this browser — must sign in.
webuiAccess.notEnforced: Inactive: Pando is running on {{host}} and is only reachable from this machine. Credentials are demanded once you start it with a non-localhost host, e.g. pando app --host 0.0.0.0.
webuiAccess.noUsers: No users configured. Add one before enabling access control.
webuiAccess.deleteMessage: Remove "{{username}}"? They will lose access immediately. Deleting the last user also turns access control off.
webuiAccess.storageNote: Passwords are stored age-encrypted in your config file, the same way provider API keys are.

sandbox.title: Command Sandbox
sandbox.description: Confines the commands the agent runs (bash, ACP terminals, skills) to the workspace and temp directories and protects Pando's own configuration. Changes apply to the next command without a restart.
sandbox.disabledWarning: Agent commands run with your full user permissions and every bash command asks for approval.
sandbox.notEnforced: The sandbox is on but this OS cannot enforce it ({{reason}}). Commands run unconfined and bash keeps asking for approval.
sandbox.envOverride: PANDO_SANDBOX={{value}} overrides the configured mode for this process.
sandbox.locked: Managed by your organization: this setting cannot be changed here.
sandbox.enabledDescription: Turn off only when a workflow cannot work inside the sandbox.
sandbox.modeHint: workspace-write: write the workspace and temp dirs. read-only: write temp only. strict: also limit reads.
sandbox.networkHint: read-only and strict always restrict the network of sandboxed commands.
sandbox.autoAllowBashDescription: Skip the bash approval prompt while the sandbox is enforced (dangerous commands still ask).
sandbox.useBwrapHint: Linux only: bubblewrap protects Pando's config files inside the workspace.
sandbox.useBwrapNotLinux: Linux only: ignored on this system.
sandbox.writableRootsHint: Directories outside the workspace that sandboxed commands may write (absolute, ~ or workspace-relative).
sandbox.denyPathsHint: Paths that sandboxed commands can neither read nor write (globs allowed), e.g. ~/.ssh.
sandbox.extendToHint: ACP terminals and skills are always sandboxed. MCP servers and subagents are opt-in.
sandbox.protectedPathsHint: Always read-only for sandboxed commands, so the agent cannot switch its own sandbox off.
